lede.pending: Signing in worked; the account is not enabled yet.
section.broken: This section did not open. You can move to another one from the menu and come back later.
signin.title: Sign in
signin.body: The panel needs an account. You can create one the first time you sign in.
account.aria: The account you signed in with
connecting.note: You can leave this page open. The service may be starting from zero while the panel is already visible.
pending.title: Account waiting
pending.body: Signing in worked. The account is not enabled yet: a person has to approve it.
pending.note: There is nothing to do from here. This page will not change on its own: reload it once the approval has happened.
proposals.title: To approve
proposals.note: None of this has reached her. What you approve is kept ready and shown later, when it is needed.
proposals.unreadable: I cannot read the proposals right now.
proposals.decideFailed: I could not record the decision. Try again later.
themes.title: Picture themes
themes.note: The display draws a new picture on one of these themes. You approve the theme, not each image: what you remove is no longer used.
themes.removeFailed: I could not remove the theme. Try again later.
themes.unreadable: I cannot read the themes right now.
themes.empty: No themes. While the list is empty the display uses the starting ones.
rhythm.title: Rhythm
rhythm.note: When the display may change its picture, and how often. The house reads the choice on its next run: saving here starts nothing and wakes no device.
rhythm.wakeNote: On battery the display wakes about every ten minutes: below that spacing some pictures are generated and nobody sees them.
rhythm.saved: Saved. The house applies it on its next run.
rhythm.saveFailed: I could not save it. Try again later.
rhythm.unreadable: I cannot read the rhythm right now.
rhythm.quietOff: No pause: the picture may change at any hour.
preferences.title: Settings
preferences.note: What the content is made of. The house reads these choices on its next run: saving here starts no generation.
preferences.languageNote: The language of what she reads, on paper and on the display. It does not follow the language of this page: content approved in one language is not approved in another.
preferences.saved: Saved. The house applies it on its next run.
preferences.saveFailed: I could not save it. Try again later.
preferences.unreadable: I cannot read the settings right now.
devices.title: Devices
devices.note: How the displays are doing. Faults appear here: nothing of the kind ever appears on the screen she looks at.
devices.unreadable: I cannot read the devices right now.
devices.empty: No device has been heard from yet.
pictures.title: Pictures
pictures.note: Every picture that has appeared on the display, newest first. They are shown as she sees them: two levels only, no greys.
pictures.unreadable: I cannot read the pictures right now.
pictures.empty: No pictures yet. The first arrives when the display asks for one.
usage.title: Usage
usage.note: What the models consumed this month. These are numbers about machines, not about her, and not a target to reach.
usage.unreadable: I cannot read the usage right now.
error.title: It did not work
error.noAuth: The panel has no sign-in configuration yet.
error.signin: Signing in did not complete. Reload the page and try again.
language.label: Language
